newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian Treasury offers A$1.4 bln of notes.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian Treasury offers A$1.4 bln of notes.

text.p: The Australian Treasury will offer a total of A$1.4 billion of Treasury notes for tender on Wednesday, the Reserve Bank of Australia said.
The tender comprises A$1.0 billion of 13-week notes and A$400 million of 26-week notes.
The Treasury last week offered a total of A$1.2 billion of notes, comprising A$200 million of five-week notes, A$800 million of 13-week notes and A$200 million of 26-week notes.
There are A$809 million of non-official holdings of T-notes maturing in the week ending August 21.
